reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports graphene's intrinsic mechanical properties and its strengthening effect in Cu/graphene composites, but it provides no data on thermal conductivity enhancement, interfacial thermal coupling, processing integrity of coatings, or irradiation resistance, leaving most key premises unsupported.
premises: Graphene has superior strength, modulus, and thermal conductivity
Graphene coating can enhance interfacial thermal coupling between W and Cu
Graphene interface increases strength in metal/graphene composites
Graphene coating remains intact and continuous during composite processing
Graphene coating improves irradiation resistance of the composite
